bibl.title: Siddhāntacandrikā
Vedāntasiddhāntacandrikā
bibl.note: A commentary on this work (Uddhāra/Udgāra) was written by Gaṅgādharendra Sarasvatī (1826) (see Dasgupta vol. 2, pg. 56 and R. Thangaswami, A Bibliographical Survey of Advaita Vedānta Literature pg. 387)

This work is complete in 50 verses. It asserts the Mīmāṃsā cannot lead to liberation, and that the Sāṅkhya, Yoga, and Nyāya śāstras are only doorkeepers to Advaita Vedānta (see R. Thangaswami, A Bibliographical Survey of Advaita Vedānta Literature pg. 387)
According to the Tanjore Descriptive Catalogue, there are 51 verses (vol. 13 pg. 5819, ms. 7694)
Tanjore vol. 13 ms. 7695 is a commentary on this work called the Siddhāntacandrikāvyākhyā Udgāraḥ
